task_description: Extend the existing OAuth role-based authorization so that READ endpoints and pages are also gated by role, not only mutations. Students may view only their own results/sessions/history (ownership via authenticated email); staff may read admin/knowledge/evaluations data per role tiers; GET /api/knowledge becomes staff-only. Preserve the no-env build invariant and graceful demo mode when auth is not configured. All user-facing text in Spanish. Update README with the role->permission matrix. Work on branch feat/web-migration-vercel-neon; do not push.

verification.summary: From web/: typecheck pass, lint pass (no warnings/errors), vitest 81 passed (68 prior + 6 read-access unit tests + 7 route-wiring tests), and no-env `next build` (all OAuth/DB/token/AI env vars unset) compiled successfully - preserving the no-env build invariant. test_quality: read-access.test.ts exercises the real authorizeSessionRead across all six ownership branches, and read-access-routes.test.ts drives the real route handlers with only getCurrentUser + DB/IO seams mocked so a dropped guard call fails CI. No Dockerfile for the web app, so docker_build skipped.

review.residual_notes: Non-blocking (v2): staff-proctor branch of POST /api/sessions takes the client-supplied studentEmail as the ownership key without validating it belongs to a known student (deliberate, documented; a proctor typo yields an orphaned staff-only session). Ordinary students remain non-spoofable.
